name: oakoss
description: Curated Claude Code plugins by Oak OSS

plugins.name: review-cycle
plugins.description: Automated multi-agent code review cycle with hook-driven gates. Spawns pr-review-toolkit reviewers in parallel (plus Codex when available), applies fixes per CLAUDE.md policy, and prevents commits on unreviewed changes.

plugins.name: pr-kit
plugins.description: Pull-request workflow toolkit: summarize review feedback, resolve merge conflicts, make diffs reviewable, and drive CI to green — gate-aware, with no unreviewed commits.

plugins.name: prose
plugins.description: Plain technical prose for Claude: an always-on output style and a cleanup skill that remove AI filler, distilled from the Google developer style guide.
